description: This file defines the Doctrine class responsible for configuring and providing access to the Doctrine ORM EntityManager within the OrangeHRM application. It sets up Doctrine with annotation metadata, caching, and connection parameters, and manages the singleton instance of the EntityManager.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for setting up and providing access to Doctrine's EntityManager in the OrangeHRM application, including configuration of caching and auto-generation of proxy classes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes Doctrine configuration, caching, and creates the EntityManager based on application configuration, setting up the database connection and metadata cache.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines whether the application is running in development mode by checking the framework's debug status.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves entity class paths from configured plugin directories.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Doctrine class, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the Doctrine EntityManager singleton.
